remarks: Welcome to 35 Faucett Street, a well-loved Stamford home offering classic character, generous living space and plenty of potential for the next owner to make it their own. The main level features hardwood floors throughout the living and dining areas, along with a striking stone fireplace that adds warmth and character to the living room. A separate dining room provides comfortable space for gatherings, while the large eat-in kitchen offers plenty of room for everyday dining.  The finished lower level provides valuable additional space with flexibility for a family room, recreation area, home office or other uses, plus a separate laundry area.  Outside, enjoy a large, level and fully fenced yard, expansive patio area and detached garage - offering plenty of room for entertaining, gardening, play or simply relaxing outdoors.  The home has been enjoyed over the years and offers an excellent opportunity for buyers looking to update and personalize a property to suit their own style and needs. Conveniently located in Stamford with easy access to shopping, dining, transportation and everyday amenities. Sale subject to Probate approval!

facts.availability: Needs probate approval, withing 60-90 days or so..
